title: Time-Dependent Dynamical Dimensional Transmutation in the $SU(2)$ Gross-Neveu Model with Time-Dependent Interaction Strength
summary: In this work we study driven $SU(2)$ Gross-Neveu (GN) model whose time-dependent interaction strength is constrained by quantum integrability within the recently developed generalized Bethe ansatz framework. Integrability requires the coupling strengths to evolve according to the same equation as the renormalization-group (RG) flow of the corresponding static theory, where time `$t$' of the time-dependent model is identified with the logarithm of the cutoff `$\ln Λ$' of the static model.
